answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Activation measurements match fine-tuned and not the other categories: layer-1 relative L2 is 0.084, layer 16 is 0.189 and layer 32 is 0.414. The final-layer jump is +0.117, direction consistency 0.705, effective rank 3.12, cosine 0.906, and mid-layer size ratio 1.021 (grows). Quantized would show flat mid-layer growth, rank about 4, consistency about 0.513 and a size ratio below 1. System-prompted would show a large layer-2 spike (31.7-64) and median first divergence 0, whereas the spike here is 0.1 and divergence is 10. Raw-score shift÷TV of 11.5 is slightly above the fine-tuned range but is closest to it. Logit agreement is 0.938, and the median first divergence of 10 and edit distance of 0.531 are at the edges of the fine-tuned and quantized ranges, so they do not decide it. Exact-match rate is 0.031. Base is ruled out because every difference is nonzero.
